evidence.excerpt: We're excited to share that KugelAudio has joined Y Combinator. We're building a sovereign foundational voice model for Europe. 30 languages, natural pronunciation, on-prem deployment, and EU-hosted by default. Six months ago we open-sourced our first model. It now sits at 100k+ monthly downloads on Hugging Face. Today we're part of Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch, working alongside some of the strongest founders building right now. This lets us push our mission forward with full force: giving…
